item.title: CONFIRMED: DONS v CELTIC OFF
item.description: CELTIC’S Premiership game with Aberdeen at Pittodrie this evening is OFF. A pitch inspection this afternoon ruled out any possibility of the mach getting the go-ahead. item.title: OXLADE-CHAMBERLAIN COUNTDOWN
